prices.note: Re-read for the darc-sport page (whole store, products.json pages 1-4, 929 products): 923 products carry a compare-at price above price (store-wide markdown, e.g. Premium Oversized Tees $35 vs $50, Premium Classic Tees $31.50 vs $45). Only 6 products have no markdown: 5 short-sleeve tees, all $45 and all one design, Big Wolf Head (Premium Oversized Tee in Black, Light Athletic Gray, All Of Us Camo; Grunge Raw Hem Box Cut Tommy Muscle Tee in Cream, Slate Gray), sizes S-3XL, plus one long-sleeve tee (excluded). Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final, DiscountApplied, sale-NN, NN%, on-sale, sale, flash-sale, further reductions); campaign-eligibility tags with no compare-at price (e.g. '10th-anniversary-sale') are not treated as markdowns. The 'SALEMENS'/'SALESHE' tags appear only on items that also carry a compare-at markdown. Short-sleeve tees only: long-sleeve, tanks, stringers, polos, button-ups, jerseys, sweaters, packs and box sets excluded.
